quote: "He is waiting on the old stone bench beneath her balcony, shoulders squared as if to carry the world on them."
"He closes his hand around the thin ivory and tucks it into the rough of his palm as if expecting to hide something precious beneath skin used to work."
"He gives a laugh that is almost a breath."
"Garr slipping away to the stables' shadow, Elys to the narrow balcony..."
"The willow-pin was in Garr's palm from the last time they'd touched it..."
"He drew a scrap of paper from his pouch and with a coin pressed a warm blob of wax to the corner... He slipped the sealed scrap beneath his tunic and laid a hand over it."
"The willow-pin was in Garr's palm from the last time they'd touched it..."
"Garr's mouth thinned. 'Westbrook's levies won't carry my name anywhere but a ledger...'"
"The willow-pin was in Garr's palm from the last time they'd touched it, small and warm."
"The letter warm against his chest. In the pocket under his tunic the sealed scrap waited..."
"Outside, beneath the eaves, Garr moved with the quiet efficiency of a man packing what must be carried..."
